title: A look at Babel Audio, which pairs anonymous strangers to record their conversations, starting at $17/hour, and bundles those recordings into AI training data (Issie Lapowsky/Bloomberg)
summary: Issie Lapowsky / Bloomberg: A look at Babel Audio, which pairs anonymous strangers to record their conversations, starting at $17/hour, and bundles those recordings into AI training data — They vent, confess and role-play with strangers, all to help machines learn how to sound human.
